name: Nissin Foods Company Limited
summary: Nissin Foods Company Limited engages in manufacturing and selling instant noodles in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Canada, Australia, the United States, Taiwan, Macau, and internationally. The company also manufactures and sells retort and frozen foods, beverages and snacks, and vegetables, as well as fruit juices, cup noodles, and sauces. In addition, it manufactures packaging materials instant noodles products; and provides publicity services. The company also trades in instant noodle, vegetable, and packaging material products, and imports beverages and food products, noodle and confectionery; as well as provides administrative management and human resource services.
